title: gypsophila repens var. alpestris
intro: Gypsophila repens var. alpestris, commonly known as Alpine Gypsophila, is a plant species in the family Caryophyllaceae. It is known for its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative properties, which make it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Gypsophila include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions. The plant has been traditionally used to treat anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual disorders, due to its sedative and antispasmodic effects.
